meta.name: what-breaks
meta.description: Assess the impact of a proposed change on dependencies and shared infrastructure. Use before touching unfamiliar or consequential systems.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 改代码前先看清会牵连哪些模块与共享组件,避免误伤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果即将改动陌生或关键系统,想先摸清连带影响
copy.tagline_en: See what a change will break across modules and shared pieces before you touch it
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to change an unfamiliar system and want to know the blast radius first.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在你改动不熟悉的或影响面大的系统之前，先评估这次改动对依赖方和共享基础设施的影响，并如实报告缺失的能力或未执行的检查。
howto.when: 当你要改动不熟悉的或影响较大的系统，或需要评估某项改动对依赖和共享设施的影响时触发；若由 @fde 调用，则复用它现有的包和范围。

say.text: 我准备改这个共享库，先帮我评估会影响哪些依赖
say.note: 会先看依赖与影响面再给结论

say.text: 这个改动上线前，哪些共享基础设施会受影响
say.note: 按方法逐项列出依赖与共享设施影响

say.text: 这是我的改动范围，先别动手，只评估影响
say.note: 只做影响评估，不改动代码

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude assesses how a proposed change affects dependencies and shared infrastructure before you touch unfamiliar or consequential systems, and reports missing capabilities or unrun checks honestly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you're about to change an unfamiliar or consequential system, or need the impact of a change on dependencies and shared infrastructure. Called by @fde, it reuses its packet and scope.

say_en.text: I'm about to change this shared library - assess which dependencies it affects.
say_en.note: Reads dependencies and impact first, then reports.

say_en.text: Before this change ships, which shared infrastructure is affected?
say_en.note: Lists dependency and shared-infra impact per the method.

say_en.text: Here's my change scope - don't act yet, just assess impact.
say_en.note: Impact assessment only, no code changes.
